summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the October 14, 2026 closing of the first tranche of a private financing under an October 13, 2026 securities purchase agreement with Hinterland Partners LLC. The company issued a secured promissory note with aggregate principal up to $641,936.66 for a purchase price up to $577,743.00, reflecting an original issue discount of up to $64,193.66; the first tranche carried a $402,743.00 price for $447,492.22 principal. The note bears a one-time 12% interest charge, matures 12 months from each funding, and is collateralized by 3,209,685 KingsCrowd Class A shares. This is a routine private debt placement, not a special situation.
